title: Elbesolar
lead: A sun rising over the Elbe. Visual identity and logo for a solar energy company.

blocks.title: Origin
blocks.text: Elbesolar plans solar energy systems in Hamburg. The company needed a mark that feels as clear and technical as its work, and as warm as the energy it works with.

blocks.caption: Brand kit · logo construction, palette, typography and applications

blocks.title: Concept & design decisions
blocks.text: A clear semicircle with freely drawn rays: constructed yet handmade. The sun rises over the river, and the mark works in colour, in one colour and at the smallest sizes.
